mapper.select: SELECT c.chat_comment_idx FROM CHAT_COMMENT c LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ASSISTANT_MODERATION m ON m.chat_comment_idx = c.chat_comment_idx WHERE c.comment_role = 'USER' AND m.moderation_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.chat_comment_idx ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_ASSISTANT_MODERATION (chat_comment_idx, is_inappropriate, toxicity_score, checked_at) VALUES (#{chatCommentIdx}, #{isInappropriate}, #{toxicityScore}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_inappropriate = VALUES(is_inappropriate), toxicity_score = VALUES(toxicity_score), checked_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT m.moderation_id, m.chat_comment_idx, m.is_inappropriate, m.toxicity_score, m.checked_at, c.chat_post_idx, c.user_idx, c.content, c.created_at AS message_created_at, u.nickname FROM ADMIN_ASSISTANT_MODERATION m JOIN CHAT_COMMENT c ON c.chat_comment_idx = m.chat_comment_idx LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = c.user_idx WHERE m.is_inappropriate = 1 ORDER BY m.checked_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN_ASSISTANT_MODERATION WHERE is_inappropriate = 1
